groups.baseline_prompt: Change the person's hairstyle to layered hair while preserving their identity, facial features, expression, pose, clothing, lighting, framing, and background.
groups.candidate_prompt: Change the hairstyle to a butterfly cut: retain long lower lengths, create shorter pronounced face-framing upper layers and voluminous curved layers sweeping away from the face. Keep the same person, recognizable face, facial proportions, expression, skin tone, clothing, pose, background, lighting and framing. Preserve the original hair color. Change hairstyle only.
groups.acceptance: Retain long lower lengths; shorter face-framing upper layers must be clear and differ from Layered Hair.

groups.baseline_prompt: Change the person's hairstyle to a bob hairstyle while preserving their identity, facial features, expression, pose, clothing, lighting, framing, and background.
groups.candidate_prompt: Change the hairstyle to a textured French bob ending around the jaw, with a softly broken outline and thin, airy, separated wispy bangs above the eyes. Keep the fringe light rather than a heavy blunt curtain. Keep the same person, recognizable facial proportions, expression, natural skin tone, original hair color, clothing, pose, lighting, framing and background. Change hairstyle only.
groups.acceptance: Jaw-length textured outline and airy separated fringe; distinct from baseline Bob Hair.

groups.baseline_prompt: Change the person's hairstyle to a shag haircut while preserving their identity, facial features, expression, pose, clothing, lighting, framing, and background.
groups.candidate_prompt: Change the hairstyle to a wolf cut with a short, choppy, voluminous crown, feathered face-framing layers and a distinctly longer, wispy back. Keep a visible contrast between the shorter upper layers and longer lower lengths, rather than a uniform shag. Keep the same person, recognizable facial proportions, expression, natural skin tone, original hair color, clothing, pose, lighting, framing and background. Change hairstyle only.
groups.acceptance: Shorter choppy crown and longer wispy back; distinct from baseline Shag Hair.

groups.baseline_prompt: Change the person's hairstyle to a side-part undercut while preserving their identity, facial features, expression, pose, clothing, lighting, framing, and background.
groups.candidate_prompt: Change the hairstyle to a Korean two-block haircut with a visibly shorter lower section at the sides and nape and a distinctly longer fuller upper section with a soft natural fringe. Show the two lengths clearly. Keep the same person, recognizable face, facial proportions, expression, skin tone, clothing, pose, background, lighting and framing. Preserve the original hair color. Change hairstyle only.
groups.acceptance: Longer upper section visibly separated from shorter sides/nape; not merely a straight fringe.

groups.baseline_prompt: Change the person's hairstyle to a curtain hairstyle with a center part while preserving their identity, facial features, expression, pose, clothing, lighting, framing, and background.
groups.candidate_prompt: Style the hair into Korean comma hair with a side part and a softly swept fringe clear of the eyes. Curve the ends of a broad front fringe inward as natural individual hair strands into a soft C shape above one brow, blending into the top. Avoid a detached curled lock, closed ring or painted loop. Keep the same person, recognizable facial proportions, expression, natural skin tone, original hair color, clothing, pose, lighting, framing and background. Change hairstyle only.
groups.acceptance: Natural curved fringe strands, not an isolated ring/U loop; distinct from baseline Curtain Hair; eyes and hair color retained.
